name: bi-platform
description: Self-Service BI & Data Analytics Platform — script điều phối cho backend + frontend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.infra:up:all: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools up -d
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools stop
scripts.infra:ps: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.yml --profile data --profile bi --profile stream --profile tools ps
